title: vFedProtoQNAS: Prototype-Guided Personalized Quantum Neural Architecture Search for Virtual Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.01718v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Quantum federated learning (QFL) has emerged as a promising approach for collaboratively training compact quantum neural networks (QNNs) over distributed private data on resource-constrained devices. However, differences in device capabilities make a single shared QNN architecture unsuitable for all clients. While personalized quantum neural architecture search (QNAS) allows each client to select a device-specific QNN, averaging parameters across structurally different QNN architectures mixes semantically inconsistent circuit operations. To address this, prototype-guided personalized QNAS for virtual FL (vFedProtoQNAS) is proposed, where model parameters are never aggregated across clients and federated collaboration is achieved through class-wise prototype sharing. Each client independently searches and trains a client-specific QNN, computes class-wise local prototypes from latent representations, and refines them using global prototype

translated_title: vFedProtoQNAS：面向虚拟联邦学习的原型引导个性化量子神经架构搜索
translated_abstract: 量子联邦学习已成为一种有前景的方法，用于在资源受限设备上对分布式私有数据进行协作训练，以构建紧凑的量子神经网络。然而，设备能力的差异使得单一的共享QNN架构无法适用于所有客户端。虽然个性化量子神经架构搜索（QNAS）允许每个客户端选择适合自身设备的QNN，但在结构不同的QNN架构之间对参数进行平均会混合语义不一致的电路操作。为解决这一问题，本文提出了面向虚拟联邦学习的原型引导个性化QNAS（vFedProtoQNAS），其中模型参数从不在客户端之间进行聚合，联邦协作通过类级别原型共享来实现。每个客户端独立搜索并训练特定于自身设备的QNN，从潜在表示中计算类级别的本地原型，并使用全局原型对其进行细化。
tldr: 提出vFedProtoQNAS框架，通过类级别原型共享而非参数聚合的方式实现虚拟联邦学习中的个性化量子神经架构搜索，使各客户端能够独立搜索并训练适配自身设备的量子神经网络，避免了结构不同架构间参数平均导致的语义不一致问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes vFedProtoQNAS, a prototype-guided personalized quantum neural architecture search framework for virtual federated learning that achieves federated collaboration through class-wise prototype sharing instead of parameter aggregation, enabling each client to independently search and train a device-specific QNN while avoiding semantic inconsistency from averaging parameters across structurally different architectures.
